nom: Aveeno Daily Moisturizing Face Lotion with Soothing Prebiotic Oat

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination dry/oily, PCOS-related acne-prone skin found it non-greasy, well absorbed, and helpful for her rosacea flare-ups.
segments.dry: Reports split: several reviewers with dry, normal-to-dry or very dry skin report good hydration and calm, comfortable skin, while two reviewers with very dry skin found it too watery, drying instantly, and leaving skin feeling more dry or red.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including combination dry/oily with acne, report it moisturizes all day without grease and helped calm rosacea flare-ups.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea, report no irritation, redness or breakouts and comfortable daily hydration; two reviewers with sensitive skin instead report tingling, redness right after application, or a lack of the sealing/moisturizing effect they expected.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes normal-to-dry, extremely sensitive skin as responding well to the lightweight, fragrance-free formula, though she still layers a heavier cream or sunscreen depending on the day.
segments.mature: One reviewer credits the lotion with brightening her older complexion as part of a routine with the matching Aveeno cleanser and night cream.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report lasting, comfortable hydration without a greasy feel; several others, including some with dry or very dry skin, found it too thin and watery, saying it doesn't moisturize as expected or dries the skin out further.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin report calmer skin and no new irritation, with one describing her rosacea as healing fast after switching from another brand; one reviewer with sensitive, dry skin instead reports her face turned red as soon as she applied it.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes the prebiotic oat formula as strengthening her skin's moisture barrier, alongside calming redness and dry patches.
concerns.blemishes: Material is limited to two reviewers who report the lotion does not cause breakouts on sensitive skin.

aspects.libelle: Thin, runny texture pours out quickly
Frequently arrives without a safety seal
Faint oat/yogurt scent despite fragrance-free labeling
No SPF included despite daily-use positioning
Strong value, a little goes a long way

extraits.texte: I’m dealing with really dry, flaky skin right now & my skin is super sensitive, I did not like the consistency of this product at all, it felt super runny & does not feel moisturizing & as soon as I put it in my face got red. I do however recommend the one for kids, you get more product for less money & you can tell the difference in thickness (the kids is on the left of my hand & on the right is the daily moisturizing face lotion) it feels really nice of the face & did not make me red at all.

Not for sensitive skin I had a tingling sensation when I applied it, too. It didn't seal in a bit. And it doesn't moisturize as expected even though it's already spring. It might be better to wait until the summer when your face gets oily, but you definitely can't use it in the winter time. Also, you can see from the picture that the texture is very thin, more like a lotion than a cream.

extraits.titre: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Perfect Daily Hydration! Lightweight, Deeply Soothing & Unscented
extraits.texte: If you need a gentle, incredibly reliable facial moisturizer that locks in deep hydration without clogging your pores, Aveeno Daily Moisturizing Face Lotion is a top-tier choice. It provides professional-grade nourishment at an affordable, drugstore price point.Here are the key points that make this facial lotion a five-star buy on Amazon:Soothes with Prebiotic Oat: Infused with pure, nourishing prebiotic oat, it instantly calms redness, tightens dry skin patches, and intensely strengthens your skin’s natural moisture barrier.Clinically Proven 24-Hour Hydration: You only need a single daily application. It absorbs incredibly fast to keep normal, dry, or highly sensitive skin feeling soft and beautifully smooth from morning until night.Ultra-Lightweight & Non-Greasy: Unlike heavy body creams that leave a sticky residue, this facial formula is designed specifically for the face and neck. It sinks right in with a weightless, matte finish that layers perfectly under daily sunscreen or makeup.100% Sensitive Skin Safe: It is completely fragrance-free, oil-free, non-comedogenic, and contains absolutely zero parabens, dyes, or harsh alcohols. It provides smooth healing without causing breakouts or burning irritated skin.It leaves your complexion looking visibly radiant and naturally healthy-looking with zero greasy shine. It is the ultimate addition to any minimalist skincare routine!

extraits.titre: New Packaging But Still A Great Moisturizer
extraits.texte: I love the older version of this and was hesitant to buy the newer one because I wasn’t sure if it was the same product. It is! New packaging on the left, old on the right. The formula is slightly different smelling (less oaty, which I liked but many didn’t based off of other reviews) but works great nonetheless. I have rosacea and dry skin so I use this under my makeup for the day and after my shower at night - no pilling and still moisturized in the morning! 10/10

Great lightweight moisturizer. A small amount was more than enough for my face and beck. Spreads quickly and absorbs quickly. Did not irritate my rosacea and sensitive skin at all. Perfect for those with sensitive skin and those who need light daily moisturization. Those who have particularly dry skin might want to opt for a heavier more moisturizing cream.

Skin Type: Combination of dry, Oily and PCOS Acne. 3rd time buying this item and will keep returning to aveeno. Non greasy and super absorbant. My rocasea flares up using Cerave but when I returned to Aveeno, its healing fast!
